meta.title: Samantha J. Brown | Co-Founder & CEO, Suzanne 3D
meta.description: Co-founder & CEO of Suzanne 3D. AI 3D models that actually work. Projects, creative work, and contact.

now.body: Suzanne turns text, a sketch, or a photo into a production-ready 3D model in minutes. Physical AI for product design, built in San Francisco, backed by Founders, Inc. and part of NVIDIA Inception.

log.entry: Launched Claude for 3D modeling: production-level models from any AI agent through the Suzanne API
First paying customers, first API contract, and a closed angel round
One-way ticket to SF for Canopy at Founders, Inc. Beta hit 120 users in its first 24 hours
Suzanne starts as a weekend hackathon project at HackPrinceton

story: I'm Samantha, co-founder & CEO of Suzanne 3D, based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Outside of Suzanne, I coach hackathons with Major League Hacking and make content about tech, startups, and college life: 22M+ views and 30k+ followers across platforms.

Before this I was a software engineer at Sicura, building frontend for security compliance tooling, and studied Computer Science & Interaction Design at SUNY Oswego, where I won the Rudolph Award for excellence in design and founded LakerHacks, the campus's annual hackathon.
